test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 25 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: UPTQ is related to OJNK in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, RMQN is related to LGKH. To which of the following options is NIMJ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

UPTQ is related to OJNK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db9c00a2f0ef0e46c5880bb8ab8d0e2e883a86b790fd3d5cd17ceeb7c048d17e.png] 

RMQN is related to LGKH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9e43b44d77d49114ea63345a6d471213593c0323e2a803e626b69cc79b773a9.png] 

Similarly, NIMJ will be related:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9e5bb3f1d49b5544337a9da3e8fb98d4af844e335c55f2f4be74f4d5d706970.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "HCGD".
